summary: A Yes vote continues the town's paramedic services special tax for four years at up to $107.50 per residential unit or per 1,000 square feet of developed nonresidential property, adjustable up to $4.00 per year.

tax.text: A Yes vote extends and increases the property tax to fund paramedic services.
tax.quote: The other seven jurisdictions are seeking up to $107.50 per dwelling or 1,000 square feet of developed nonresidential property, with increases of up to $4 a year.

tax.text: A No vote does not extend and increase the property tax for paramedic services.
tax.quote: The other seven jurisdictions are seeking up to $107.50 per dwelling or 1,000 square feet of developed nonresidential property, with increases of up to $4 a year.
